input: Label and organize all the spice jars alphabetically

gold.taskTitle: Label and organize spice jars alphabetically
gold.taskDescription: Sort and label all spice jars in alphabetical order in the user's kitchen or storage area.

questions.title: How many spice jars do you currently have?
questions.description: Understanding the quantity helps estimate the time and materials needed.

questions.title: Where are the spices stored right now?
questions.description: Knowing the current storage location — drawer, cabinet, countertop rack — shapes the organizational approach.

questions.title: Do the jars already have labels, or are they bare?
questions.description: Determines whether new labels need to be created or existing ones just need to be reorganized.

questions.title: What labeling method do you want to use?
questions.description: Options include handwritten labels, printed labels, a label maker, or chalkboard stickers — each requires different tools.

questions.title: Are the jars uniform in size and shape?
questions.description: Mixed jar sizes may affect how they fit on a rack or shelf alphabetically.

questions.title: Do you need to buy any supplies before starting?
questions.description: Identifies whether labels, a label maker, new jars, or a rack still need to be purchased.

questions.title: Is there a specific deadline you want this done by?
questions.description: Helps prioritize and schedule the task within the user's available time.
